Privacy Policy

Last Updated: October 2024

At 24x7 RO Support, we value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our website or book our services.

1. Information We Collect

When you book a service, we may collect the following information:

  • Name
  • Mobile Number
  • Full Address & Pin Code
  • RO Brand and Issue Details

2. How We Use Your Information

We use your information solely for the following purposes:

  • To dispatch a technician to your location.
  • To contact you regarding your booking.
  • To provide customer support and process warranty claims.
  • To send occasional service reminders (you can opt out anytime).

3. Data Sharing & Security

We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. Your data is shared only with our assigned technicians for the purpose of fulfilling your service request. We implement standard security measures to protect your data.

4. Third-Party Links

Our website may contain links to third-party sites (like WhatsApp). We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those sites.

5. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

Email: support@24x7rosupport.com

Phone: 08062180546
